name: Summer Day Camp (Grades 1-5)
description_short: A general summer day camp at the Bath YMCA for children entering grades 1-5 in fall 2027. Activities include sports, arts, outdoor games, pool time, beach trips and weekly excursions.
refund_policy_summary: There is a $35 registration fee per camper, charged once. It cannot be refunded or transferred. A $25 deposit per week per camper holds each week's spot. Deposits cannot be refunded or transferred, and they count toward tuition. Fees are due within 7 days of enrollment confirmation, and full payment is due the Friday before a session starts.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers get pool time/free swim throughout camp, plus beach trips. Structured swim lessons with certified instructors cost extra and run 8:00-9:00AM, Monday-Friday, for that week's campers only. Financial aid is available for lessons. The Y has a separate Swim Test Policy page.
